text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hm. Looks like there's a whole lotta eyes on the scrimmage today.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Heh, seems like a good learnin' opportunity!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: (I can't see a dang thing here! How am I s'posed to see how da race's goin' when all these heads are blockin' my view?!)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: (Grah! I can't believe I'm missin' out on such a great race!)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: (Guess the only thing I'm learnin' today is that I gotta get taller…)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Disappointed after her bout of misfortune, Tamamo Cross remains in low spirits during our training session.
